title: Cobblemon & Create: Neoforge
description: This project adds cobblemon and create together
body:
This project blends Cobblemon’s Pokémon-style adventure with Create’s mechanical automation for a rich survival experience.
Explore an expanded world with new biomes, structures, and building blocks, automate farms and factories, train and battle Pokémon, and enjoy quality-of-life improvements like backpacks, minimaps, voice chat, and improved building tools.
